module: "Examples" window (fg_examples) of the Flowgraph editor. It loads (once, cached) all *flow.json files from the /lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/examples/ folder, arranges them in a tree by subfolder (beginner, intermediate, expert, nodes first), offers a search and, on clicking an example, opens a new flowgraph project created from its data (without a saved file name). Arrow-key navigation is possible via the "NodeLibrary" action map.
notes: Examples are sorted by exampleOrder (10^10 by default); the description comes from the description field of the .flow.json.
The examplesLookup cache is shared at module level: it is not reloaded while the game is running.
findExamples references examplesLookup, which must already have been loaded by loadExamples.

attach.desc: Associates the manager and resets the search.

init.desc: Registers the window, creates the search utility and loads the examples.

loadExamples.desc: Walks FS:findFiles over the example .flow.json files, builds the tree (res) and the flat table (lookup) with their JSON content, then caches them.

getExamplesLookup.desc: Returns the tree and the flat table (via loadExamples).

createNode.desc: Requests validation of the selected item at the next display (doClick).

navigateList.desc: Moves the keyboard selection in the list.

drawSearchInput.desc: Draws the "Find" field, the clear button and the help.

findExamples.desc: Submits each example to the search utility.

match.desc: Searched string (not used directly in the body, inferred from code).

findStuff.desc: Re-runs the search if the text has changed and fills self.results.

highlightText.desc: Displays a label, highlighting in orange the occurrences of the searched text.

displayTreeView.desc: Displays the full tree of examples.

recursiveTreeView.desc: Recursively displays a tree node: sorted examples then subfolders.

manageClick.desc: If the item is clicked (or validated by keyboard), creates a manager via core_flowgraphManager.addManager and makes it active in the editor.

arrowHelper.desc: Counts the item in the navigable list and draws the keyboard selection frame.

handleActionMap.desc: When the window has focus, pushes the "NodeLibrary" action map for arrow-key navigation.

draw.desc: Draws the Examples window (search or tree).
